player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} ({role}) a cikin wasan Pennies na Daidaitawa na zagaye na {num_rounds}. - Kowane zagaye, aika [heads] ko [tails] (ko [h], [t]). - Idan zaɓin ku ya dace da abokin hamayyar ku, Mai kunnawa 0 ya lashe zagaye; in ba haka ba Mai kunnawa 1 ya ci nasara. Amsa tare da zaɓinku a cikin tsari '[heads]' ko '[tails] ].

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin ba daidai ba; don Allah a shigar da "[heads]" ko "[tails]".

message.round_match: Mai kunnawa 0 ya zaɓi {choice0}; Mai kunnawa 1 ya zaɓi {choice1}. Match -> Mai kunnawa 0 ya ci nasara
message.round_mismatch: Mai kunnawa 0 ya zaɓi {choice0}; Mai kunnawa 1 ya zaɓi {choice1}. Rashin daidaituwa -> Mai kunnawa 1 ya ci nasara.

outcome.p0_wins: Mai kunnawa 0 ya lashe karin zagaye.
outcome.p1_wins: Mai kunnawa 1 ya lashe karin zagaye.
